name: Raman Technique-Aligned Procedure Profile (ramanTAPP)
abstract: Raman vibrational spectroscopy extension of the base TAPP definition. CORE-ONLY DRAFT: the native technique layer is empty. Raman has no ADA detail schema and no technique property in any ADA record, so there was nothing to seed one from and none was invented - no laser wavelength, grating or objective appears here. This registers the procedure skeleton and needs Phase 0 seed papers before it says anything Raman-specific. Generated from draftTAPPs/RAMAN_TAPP_draft_v2.csv by tools/build_tapp.py.
